name: METAR / TAF
author: e2jk
description: Flight-category indicator (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR) for your favorite airports, with a METAR/TAF detail popup

barWidget.description: Flight-category letters for configured airports; click for full METAR/TAF detail

schema.label: Airports (ICAO)
schema.description: Comma-separated ICAO station identifiers, e.g. EBAW,EBBR,EBCI

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Metric: °C, km, hPa. Imperial: °F, mi, inHg. Wind speed always stays in knots, the aviation standard everywhere.

schema.label: Show TAF
schema.description: Include the Terminal Aerodrome Forecast under each station's METAR.
